outcome: Supersede Decision 0018 with an Adopt/Revise/Reject task-store design that retains typed domain state, lifecycle invariants, recordVersion and taskRevision; simplifies the file engine; separates domain, persistence, and repository integration; rejects Git as live transactional storage; proves the backend-neutral TaskStore contract with production FileTaskStore and a conformance/reference-only SQLite adapter; leaves later promotion of SQLite and PostgreSQL to selectable canonical local backends for separate tasks and decisions; drops S3; and defines audit, recovery, migration, compatibility, security, and counterfactual-test boundaries

authority.reference: User direction delivered 2026-08-13: SQLite is initially conformance/reference-only; separately retain already-identified work for selectable canonical SQLite and PostgreSQL local backends; do no further research or design

nextSafeAction: Finish the superseding decision around FileTaskStore as the sole initial production backend and SQLite as conformance/reference-only, while deferring canonical SQLite and PostgreSQL promotion to T-0042 and T-0043
